Omniadmin-only bootstrap driven exclusively by the system Shared Realm Provisioning configuration. No request body is accepted. Creates/reuses the shared internal/B2C realm and client, internal organization, internal realm group, invited administrator, and default Liferay company OIDC connection. The group receives no administrator role. Retries reuse resources; configuration must explicitly permit adoption of unmanaged resources. Optionally configures an upstream SAML sign-in option from federation metadata. Does not set passwords. Partial resources remain for reconciliation on failure. validateOnly performs preflight reads without sending mail or changing configuration.
